hooks.command: [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] || exit 0; log=/tmp/codice-cloud-session.log; if bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/cloud-session-start.sh" >"$log" 2>&1; then echo "codice: dependencies installed (run pnpm dev:up to start the Worker; log: $log)"; else echo "codice: cloud session setup FAILED (log: $log)"; tail -n 30 "$log"; fi; true
